patterns.note: Asymmetrical section layouts with large, bold headings on one side and supporting content (lists, image grids) on the other, creating dynamic visual balance.
High-contrast color blocking using vibrant orange, off-white, and dark grey/black to clearly define distinct content sections and guide the eye.
The header transforms on scroll, with the 'Menu' text link changing into a distinct yellow button and the logo slightly shrinking, while remaining sticky at the top.
A playful illustration in the hero section appears to use a fixed or parallax effect, remaining in place as the background scrolls up behind it.
Numbered lists are consistently used to break down services, processes, or key points into easily digestible, sequential steps.

technique_notes: A sticky header is implemented that dynamically changes its appearance, such as button styles and size, after the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Sections are designed with full-bleed background colors that alternate between vibrant orange, off-white, and dark grey to visually segment content and create clear transitions.
Scroll-triggered animations subtly reveal content sections with a fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized bold headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter body text and occasional uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounded corners on buttons and cards.
design_tokens.spacing: airy hero, balanced content sections with generous padding.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a playful, almost irreverent brand name ('Crappy Presentations') is cleverly contrasted with a bold, clean, and highly structured design. The vibrant orange, custom cartoonish illustrations, and clear content hierarchy create a memorable and approachable yet professional aesthetic that stands out from typical corporate presentation sites.
